summary: A recognized meteorite listed as a find. The finder B. F. Wilson wrote in November 1888 that it fell within thirty yards of him while he was at work (quoted by Merrill, 1910), and an 1888 newspaper confirms he brought the stone in for analysis. This is a possible record correction, not a new meteorite.

sources.label: Savannah Morning News, Nov. 7, 1888, p. 6 (Wilson brings the stone in)
